title: New public mathematical research from AI models
lead: OpenAI has shared mathematical results from a research model.
happened: On October 6, OpenAI published a collection of mathematical results produced with an internal model. The organization made the results available in a public repository. It also provided selected reasoning summaries and information about how the results were produced. Some proofs were formalized in Lean, a language that can check mathematical reasoning. The public files allow researchers to examine the arguments more carefully than they could from a simple announcement.
matters: Publishing the underlying materials gives mathematicians an opportunity to check the work and understand where AI research is useful. Independent scrutiny is essential to determine whether a result is both valid and genuinely new.
limits: The announcement does not independently establish that every result is correct or important. Additional expert review is needed.
analogy: Showing your work lets someone else check the answer.
